battle.name: 常山之戰
battle.brief: 至德元年(756年)六月，安史大將史思明率范陽精騎增援常山；李光弼已自井陘攻入常山郡，郭子儀出井陘會師，兩軍合擊於郡東嘉山，大破叛軍，河北諸郡歸降十餘。卡面的埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，與本役相隔約三千八百年，不在現場；同期唐軍步軍以長矛結陣、騎兵用長槊與明光鎧，與之同一戰術位置。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 安史之亂中期，河北戰線分成兩套指揮系統對峙。一邊是重建中的唐朝中央：至德元年(756年)玄宗西幸蜀地、肅宗李亨即位靈武之後，朝廷以河東節度使李光弼部為河北主攻，以朔方節度使郭子儀部為策應，兩軍出太行井陘口，歸中書門下與兵部調度，糧秣由河東、河北各道轉運；兵種以朔方、河東兩鎮蕃漢騎兵為骨幹，配步軍長矛手、弩手、陌刀隊與披明光鎧的重騎，用以壓制叛軍在河北的步卒與游騎。一邊是安祿山建立的燕國：安祿山一身兼平盧、范陽、河東三鎮節度使，河北道的兵權、財賦與人事盡歸其手，叛軍以契丹、奚、漢人混編的騎兵為主力，攻城倚賴雲梯、飛石、壕壘與巢車。史思明以范陽節度使總督河北戰事，常山郡是他南下太行、接濟關中兵馬的支撐點，所以唐軍一舉奪下常山，他必以精騎星夜來救。常山為北方重鎮，郡治在今河北正定，太行井陘口在其西，東接河北平原，這一郡一關的取捨，就是雙方在河北爭奪的焦點。
countriesEn: This battle belongs to the middle phase of the An Lushan rebellion, when the front in Hebei was contested between two separate command systems. On one side stood the reconstructed central government of the Tang. After Xuanzong fled west to Shu in 756 and Suzong took the throne at Lingwu, the court gave Li Guangbi, military governor of Hedong, the main offensive in Hebei and assigned Guo Ziyi, military governor of Shufang, to support him. The two columns marched out through the Jingxing gap in the Taihang range, took their orders from the Secretariat and the Ministry of War, and drew grain and supplies from the circuits of Hedong and Hebei. Their strength lay in the veteran steppe and Han cavalry of the Shufang and Hedong garrisons, backed by spearmen, crossbowmen, the modelled-blade foot guard and heavy cavalry wearing bright armour, used to pin down the rebels' infantry and their raiding parties in Hebei. On the other side stood the state of Yan created by An Lushan, who held the military governorships of Pinglu, Fanyang and Hedong at once: the military command, revenue and appointments of Hebei circuit were in his hands, and the rebel army was built mainly of cavalry recruited among Khitan, Xi and Han, with scaling ladders, stone-throwers, trenches and siege towers for attacks on walled towns. Shi Siming, military governor of Fanyang, directed operations in Hebei, and Changshan commandery was the hinge on which his thrust south through the Taihang and his effort to sustain the drive on Guanzhong depended; the moment the Tang seized it, he had to bring up his best riders by night. Changshan was a major northern garrison, its seat at present-day Zhengding in Hebei, with the Jingxing pass on its western side and the open plain of Hebei to the east. The struggle over one commandery and one pass was therefore the true focus of the contest in Hebei.
people: 史冊留下姓名的，以唐軍一側為多。河東節度使李光弼是取常山的主攻：他自太行東進，奪井陘而入常山郡，破城之後分兵略定郡內諸縣，河北州縣多望風歸附。朔方節度使郭子儀是關鍵的第二支力量，他率兵出井陘與李光弼會師，兩軍合成一線，才在常山郡東嘉山與史思明正面交鋒；此役之後他名位更重，也立刻成為朝中猜忌的對象，監軍宦官進讒，詔令諸軍罷兵，李光弼獨領河北，統一指揮反而落空。叛軍方面的主角是安祿山的大將史思明，契丹出身，與安祿山同鄉，善騎射，領范陽精騎，是安史聯軍最能打的統帥之一；另被記名的是常山太守顏杲卿，他拒守郡城，至德元年正月為史思明所破被擒，其後押送洛陽遇害，與族弟平原太守顏真卿同陷叛軍之手。朝廷高層方面，玄宗倉促入蜀，肅宗在靈武即位，收復河北的方略由同平章事房琯主持，兵部尚書嚴挺之等參預其事，房琯率軍與史思明戰於陳留清溝失利，河北的局勢因此更加危急。
peopleEn: Most of the names recorded for this battle belong to the Tang side. Li Guangbi, military governor of Hedong, led the assault on Changshan: he marched east out of the Taihang range, took Jingxing and entered Changshan commandery, and after storming the city detached troops to pacify the counties of the commandery, so that many prefectures and counties in Hebei submitted. Guo Ziyi, military governor of Shufang, was the second and decisive force; he led troops out through Jingxing to join Li Guangbi, and only after the two armies were merged into one line did they engage Shi Siming face to face at Jialshan east of the district seat of Changshan. After this victory his standing grew still heavier, and he became at once an object of suspicion at court: eunuch supervisors slandered him, the emperor ordered the various columns to disband, and Li Guangbi was left to hold Hebei alone, so that unified command fell apart. On the rebel side the central figure is An Lushan's great general Shi Siming, a Khitan by origin and a fellow townsman of An Lushan, skilled with the bow and the lance, who commanded the elite cavalry of Fanyang and was among the ablest commanders of the An-Shi coalition. Another name recorded is Yan Gaoqing, governor of Changshan, who held the city, was defeated and taken by Shi Siming in the first month of the Zhide era, and was later carried off to Luoyang and killed; he belonged to the same clan as his kinsman Yan Zhenqing, governor of Pingyuan, who likewise fell into rebel hands. At the top of the court, Xuanzong hurried off to Shu and Suzong was proclaimed at Lingwu; the strategy for recovering Hebei was directed by the chancellor Fang Guan, with such men as Minister of War Yan Tingzhi taking part, and Fang Guan lost a battle against Shi Siming at Qinggou in Chenliu, which made the situation in Hebei more critical still.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛是早王朝時期(約公元前3100年)已出現的兵器：銅或青銅矛頭安在木杆上，埃及人用它守城垣、也用它收復失地。它與公元756年的常山之戰相隔約三千八百年，絕不會出現在常山郡東的戰場上，但它在戰術上的位置可以對照唐軍的裝備：長柄矛正是唐軍步軍的骨幹，前排持矛結陣抵住來騎、後排以弩矢覆蓋，敵騎衝陣時先被矛林與拒馬卡住，再由陌刀隊與重騎反衝，這正是常山會戰中唐軍頂住范陽精騎的基本辦法。與之配合的還有橫刀、步盾與明光鎧甲，騎兵用長槊與角弓，攻城則靠雲梯、飛石、壕壘與載人的攻城車；常山郡的城牆與唐軍的圍壘是雙方投入工匠最多的地方。糧秣方面，井陘道是太行東麓唯一能讓重車與攻城器械通過的缺口，唐軍的糧車與輜重全靠這條道北運，井陘一失，或常山周邊道路被叛軍游騎切斷，屯軍便撐不了多久；馬匹同樣是瓶頸，叛軍精騎來去如風，靠的是范陽與河北的馬場，兩軍在常山郡周邊的騎兵對峙，本身就是一場馬力與草料的消耗戰。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is an Egyptian spear of the Early Dynastic period, attested from about 3100 BCE: a copper or bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft, used by the Egyptians to hold city walls and later to recover lost ground. It stands roughly three thousand eight hundred years away from the battle of Changshan in AD 756 and could not possibly be on the field east of the Changshan district seat, but its place in the order of battle has a clear parallel in Tang equipment. The long-handled spear was the backbone of Tang foot soldiers: the front rank held spears in a solid formation against charging cavalry, the rear ranks covered them with crossbow bolts, and an enemy charge was first checked by the spear wall and by anti-cavalry obstacles, after which the modelled-blade guard and the heavy cavalry counter-charged; that was the basic method by which the Tang army held off Shi Siming's elite riders at Changshan. Working with the spears were the cross-handed sabres, the foot shields and the bright armour of the armoured cavalry; the mounted troops used long lances and horn bows; and for the assault on the city the Tang relied on scaling ladders, stone-throwers, trenches and siege wagons carrying men up the walls. The walls of Changshan and the besiegers' lines were where both sides put the most craftsmen to work. Supply was the other constant: the Jingxing track was the only gap in the eastern Taihang through which heavy wagons and siege gear could pass, and every grain convoy and baggage train of the Tang army came up that way; if Jingxing were lost, or the roads around Changshan cut by rebel raiders, the besieging army could not have held out long. Horses were a second bottleneck, for the rebel cavalry moved with the speed of the wind on the pastures of Fanyang and Hebei, and the long cavalry confrontation fought around Changshan was in itself a contest of horseflesh and fodder.
tactics: 常山之戰的戰法可以分成三段。第一段是取城：李光弼部自井陘東進，先以騎兵掃清沿途的叛軍游騎，再以步卒四面築壘、填壕、搭雲梯，攀城奪下常山郡治；史書記李光弼克常山郡之後軍中一度缺糧，全賴井陘道不斷接上的糧隊，以及郡內響應者的接應，才穩住陣腳。第二段是反擊：史思明得知常山失守，率范陽精騎晝夜兼程直撲唐軍營壘，企圖在唐軍立足未穩時把常山奪回；郭子儀出井陘與李光弼會師之後，兩軍合為一線，據常山郡東嘉山一帶高處佈陣，具體布陣諸史不詳，可推想是以弩手與步槊手列前、騎兵列於兩翼，待叛軍騎兵反覆衝陣、銳氣已衰，才下令全軍進擊，正面咬住敵騎。第三段是追擊與接管：叛軍騎兵一旦在平原上被正面截斷，衝鋒的縱深消失便迅速崩散，唐軍以精騎尾追追殲，並分兵接管常山郡各縣、招撫河北州郡，形成以常山為支點的推進。整場戰鬥的關鍵，是把兩支分散的唐軍合成一線，再用長矛方陣與重騎的配合磨掉對方騎兵衝鋒的慣性，而不是各自為戰，讓叛軍游騎逐次消耗唐軍的糧道。
tacticsEn: The fighting at Changshan can be divided into three phases. The first was the reduction of the city: Li Guangbi's column advanced east from Jingxing, first clearing the rebel raiders from the road with cavalry, then having the foot soldiers build lines on all four sides, fill the ditches and raise scaling ladders to take the district seat by storm. The histories record that after taking Changshan commandery the army at one point ran short of grain and held its ground only because the grain train kept coming up the Jingxing track and because inhabitants of the commandery came forward to help. The second phase was the counter-stroke: when Shi Siming learned that Changshan had been lost he led the elite cavalry of Fanyang day and night straight at the Tang camp, hoping to retake the city before the Tang could settle in; once Guo Ziyi came out through Jingxing and joined Li Guangbi, the two armies were merged into a single line and took up position on the heights east of the Changshan district seat, in the region of Jialshan. The exact order of deployment is not recorded, but it may reasonably be reconstructed as crossbowmen and foot lancers in front with the cavalry on the flanks, waiting until Shi Siming's riders had charged repeatedly and spent their edge before the whole line was ordered forward to meet them squarely. The third phase was pursuit and consolidation: once rebel cavalry had been checked in the open and cut off, the depth of the charge was gone and the formation broke up quickly; the Tang sent cavalry after them and detached troops to take over the counties of Changshan commandery and to persuade the prefectures of Hebei to submit, forming a drive pivoting on Changshan. The key of the whole engagement was to merge two separated Tang columns into one line and then to use the spear formations and the heavy cavalry to wear away the momentum of the rebel charge, instead of fighting piecemeal and letting rebel raiders wear down the Tang supply line by degrees.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，只能列出史籍確有記載的幾項。安祿山起兵時在平盧、范陽、河東三鎮合計擁兵約十五萬，其中精騎數萬，這是河北戰場雙方兵力的底數；史思明領范陽精騎，兵以數萬計，具體名目諸說並存。常山城池不大，位置卻極關鍵：郡治在今河北正定，距井陘口約一百五十里（一里約合今五百米），是太行東麓通向河北平原的門戶；常山與范陽（幽州治所在）相距不足六百里，所以史思明的援軍能在一夜之間殺到，也意味著他一旦失利就再沒有第二道屏障。李光弼、郭子儀兩軍會合時的具體人數史無明文；三年後至德二年(757年)平定河北時，九節度使聯軍合計三十三萬一千人，叛軍方面亦有十五萬之號，兩者可作參照而不可直接套用到本役。戰後河北歸降的州郡，舊唐書記為「河北諸郡歸降者十餘」，即至少十餘郡。戰役的時間在至德元年(756年)六月。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few, and only those actually recorded in the histories can be given. When An Lushan rose he commanded in the three circuits of Pinglu, Fanyang and Hedong a total of about one hundred and fifty thousand men, of whom several tens of thousands were cavalry; that was the base on which the opposing forces in Hebei were built, while Shi Siming led the elite cavalry of Fanyang with a force counted by tens of thousands, the exact figure being a matter of several accounts. The city of Changshan was not large, but its position was critically important: the seat of the commandery lay at present-day Zhengding, about one hundred and fifty li from the Jingxing pass, one li being about five hundred metres today, and it was the gateway from the eastern foothills of the Taihang onto the plain of Hebei. Changshan and Fanyang, where the seat of Youzhou lay, were less than six hundred li apart, which is why Shi Siming's relieving force could arrive in a single night, and equally why he had no second line of defence once he was beaten. The exact numbers of Li Guangbi's and Guo Ziyi's troops when they joined are not recorded. Three years later, when Hebei was settled in 757, the alliance of nine military governors counted in total 331,000 men, while the rebel side was also credited with 150,000; both figures may be used as a reference but cannot simply be applied to this battle. As for the prefectures that submitted in Hebei after the victory, the Old Book of Tang records that more than ten came over, that is, at least a dozen or so. The battle itself took place in the sixth month of the Zhide era, the sixth month of AD 756.
cause: 起戰的緣由有遠近兩層。遠因在天寶末年的體制：安祿山一身兼任平盧、范陽、河東三鎮節度使，擁兵十五萬，河北道的軍政、財賦與人事幾乎全由他一人裁斷，朝廷削藩不成反受其制，天寶十四載(755年)十一月他以「奉密詔討楊國忠」為名在范陽起兵，河北、山西、河南相繼淪陷。至德元年(756年)六月潼關失守、七月長安淺陷，玄宗西幸蜀地，肅宗李亨在靈武即位；關中糜爛之際，河北官軍退守太行山東麓，收復常山便是重整北線的第一個目標。近因是常山本身：常山太守顏杲卿拒守郡城，至德元年正月為史思明攻破並擒去，河北人心為此分崩；同年秋，朝廷派同平章事房琯為招討使統兵，與史思明戰於陳留清溝失利，唐廷在河北的處境更見危急。李光弼自井陘東進奪回常山，等於拔掉叛軍插在太行山裡的一顆釘子；史思明既不能坐失此地，也不能再讓河北諸郡望風歸唐，於是傾巢出騎北上，一場原本只為收復一郡的戰役，就這樣被拉成河北平原上的正面會戰。
causeEn: The outbreak of this fighting had both a distant and an immediate layer. The distant cause lay in the institutions of the late Tianbao era: An Lushan held the three military governorships of Pinglu, Fanyang and Hedong at once, commanded some 150,000 men, and virtually decided the military, financial and personnel affairs of Hebei circuit by himself; the court's attempt to check him had the opposite effect, and in the eleventh month of the fourteenth year of Tianbao, 755, he rose in Fanyang under the pretext of carrying a secret edict to punish Yang Guozhong, and Hebei, Shanxi and Henan fell away in turn. In the sixth month of 756 the pass of Tong was lost and Chang'an was entered, Xuanzong fled to Shu and Suzong was proclaimed at Lingwu; while the capital region lay in ruins the Tang forces in Hebei fell back to the eastern foothills of the Taihang, and recovering Changshan became the first objective of the northern front. The immediate cause was Changshan itself: Yan Gaoqing, governor of Changshan, held the city and was defeated and taken by Shi Siming in the first month of the year, and the hearts of the people in Hebei were broken by it; in the autumn of the same year the court sent the chancellor Fang Guan as recruiting commissioner with an army, and he was beaten by Shi Siming at Qinggou in Chenliu, so that the Tang position in Hebei grew yet more desperate. By taking Changshan from the direction of Jingxing, Li Guangbi pulled out the nail the rebels had driven into the Taihang; Shi Siming could neither let the place go nor allow the prefectures of Hebei to defect wholesale to the Tang, so he came north with everything he had, and a campaign that had begun as the recovery of a single commandery was stretched into a set-piece battle on the plain of Hebei.
impact: 這一仗的意義不只在殲滅數量，更在雙方地盤與士氣的此消彼長。唐軍在常山郡東嘉山擊敗范陽精騎，等於向河北宣告安史聯軍並非不可擊敗：叛軍騎兵雖然來去如風，一旦在正面交鋒中被步槊方陣與重騎頂住，銳氣便會崩；河北諸郡因此陸續歸順，唐軍在太行東麓取得一個可以屯兵、可以轉運糧秣的支點，為其後收復兩京鋪了路。史思明退回范陽，河北再沒有可進可退的縱深，安史聯軍的攻勢由盛轉衰；兩年後安祿山被其子安慶緒所殺，史思明再殺安慶緒奪位，卻已無力再圖中原，這條反轉的線索正是從常山開始的。另一面則是朝廷對軍頭的猜忌：此役之後，監軍宦官進讒諸將，詔令各軍罷兵，李光弼獨領河北而無總帥，至德二年(757年)九節度使聯軍在貝州城下久攻不下、糧盡議退，唐軍平叛的戰機因此一再耽誤；房琯兵敗被貶之後，河北戰線更無得力的中樞。從更長的視角看，常山之戰之後，河朔地區的漢人節度使與藩鎮在平亂過程中迅速坐大，中央威信再未恢復；八年之後安史之亂雖平，唐室的衰勢卻已無可逆轉。
impactEn: The significance of this victory lies less in the numbers destroyed than in the reversal of territory and morale. Beating the elite cavalry of Fanyang at Jialshan east of Changshan announced to Hebei that the An-Shi coalition was not invincible: the rebel horse rode fast indeed, but once it was checked head-on by the spear formations and the heavy cavalry its edge was gone. Many prefectures of Hebei accordingly submitted, and the Tang army gained a foothold in the eastern Taihang where it could quarter troops and shift supplies, a base for what came later in the recovery of the two capitals. Shi Siming withdrew to Fanyang, Hebei no longer had the depth for advance or retreat, and the offensive of the An-Shi coalition turned from strength to weakness. Two years later An Lushan was killed by his own son An Qingxu, and Shi Siming killed An Qingxu in turn and seized the throne, yet he no longer had the strength to aim at the Central Plain; the thread of this reversal begins at Changshan. The other side of the matter is the court's mistrust of its generals. After this battle eunuch supervisors slandered the commanders, the emperor ordered the separate columns to disband, and Li Guangbi was left to hold Hebei without a supreme commander; in 757 the alliance of nine military governors lay before the walls of Beizhou unable to take the city and finally debated retreat because the grain had run out, so that the opportunity to end the rebellion was missed again and again, and once Fang Guan was demoted after his defeat there was no capable centre of gravity left on the Hebei front. Seen from farther off, after Changshan the Han Chinese military governors and feudatories of Hetao swelled rapidly during the process of suppression, and the authority of the centre was never restored. Eight years later the rebellion was over, but the decline of the Tang could no longer be reversed.
result: 結果是唐軍的大勝。史思明自范陽帶來的精騎在常山郡東嘉山被正面擊破，部眾死傷甚眾，餘眾收攏退回范陽；具體斬獲數字史無定論，舊唐書僅記「大破賊眾」，另一些記載稱斬首數萬級、俘虜與馬匹以千計，皆屬諸說並存，寧可存疑。常山郡及郡內諸縣重回唐朝之手，河北諸郡歸降者十餘，唐軍在太行東麓站穩腳跟，改置軍鎮鎮守，河北防務重新交到朔方、河東兩鎮手上。對安史聯軍而言，這是起兵以來在河北正面會戰中的第一次失利，安祿山為此窘急，舊唐書記他「圖欲卻投范陽」，河北人心亦由此更多地倒向唐廷。戰役的影響並未就此終止：史思明退回北方後仍盤據范陽多年，殺安慶緒而自居帝位，其後又被其子史朝義所弒，到廣德元年(763年)叛亂才隨史朝義的敗亡而徹底平定。此役另一項成果是軍事經驗的累積：河北平原上的大規模騎兵會戰、步騎配合與糧道攻防，都為唐軍此後在河洛與中原的作戰留下了可沿用的法子。
resultEn: The result was a great Tang victory. The elite cavalry Shi Siming had brought from Fanyang was broken head-on at Jialshan east of Changshan, with heavy loss of life among the men, and the survivors were gathered up and driven back to Fanyang. The exact returns are a matter of dispute: the Old Book of Tang merely says that the rebels were utterly defeated, while other accounts speak of tens of thousands killed and of prisoners and horses taken by the thousand, all of them accounts that differ and are best left in doubt. Changshan commandery and its counties returned to Tang hands, more than ten prefectures of Hebei submitted, the Tang set up a military seat at Changshan, and the defence of Hebei passed again into the hands of the Shufang and Hedong commands. For the An-Shi coalition this was the first defeat suffered in a set-piece battle in Hebei since the rising began; An Lushan was badly embarrassed by it, the Old Book of Tang recording that he wanted to retreat to Fanyang, and the hearts of Hebei turned further to the Tang. The consequences did not end there. Shi Siming remained entrenched in the north for years, killed An Qingxu and took the throne himself, and was later killed by his own son Shi Chaoyi; only in 763, with the defeat and death of Shi Chaoyi, was the rebellion finally extinguished. Another gain of the battle was the accumulation of military experience: large cavalry actions on the plain of Hebei, the cooperation of foot and horse, and the attack and defence of supply lines all left the Tang army methods it could reuse in the fighting in Heluo and the Central Plain.
